takes.title: Short run with alternating arm drive
takes.actionDescription: The performer runs through the brief take with springy strides and flexed elbows, keeping the cadence steady to the last frame.

takes.title: Run into a shorter step
takes.actionDescription: The performer runs with the elbows bent, then shortens the last stride and opens the arms slightly as the pace eases.

takes.title: Accelerate into a run
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with the arms low and short steps, quickens the feet, and brings the elbows up into a running rhythm.

takes.title: Forward jumps between steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes small setup steps between jumps and brings the arms up with a more pronounced forward takeoff late in the sequence.

takes.title: Small sideways jump
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps in, bends the knees and shifts sideways with one arm out, then absorbs the landing and steps upright.

takes.title: Turn in Place with Cross-Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step and uses small crossing steps to turn through several headings, briefly swinging the arms out. The take ends with another step still in progress.
takes.reviewNote: Exact BVH match to 106_06, whose visual pass found small cross-steps and turns. The original Jump Twist label differs. Check denser playback for a jump.

takes.title: Walk up and over an obstacle mime
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises a knee high during forward travel, briefly lifts both feet in succession, then resumes lower walking steps and turns slightly.

takes.title: Step onto a level and walk down
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks in, lifts one knee high to step up, then lowers through the knees and takes several descending steps. The source identifies an elevated step.

takes.title: Step over with arms spread
takes.actionDescription: The performer approaches in short strides, reaches one leg forward in a longer raised step with the arms held out, and continues walking.

takes.title: Small toss-and-catch mime
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts one hand from chest height, makes a small upward tossing motion, then brings the hand back up before lowering the arms.

takes.title: Throw-and-catch mime with a knee bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers into a small crouch with the hands forward, straightens and raises one hand, then turns through a follow-up reach.

takes.title: Twisting dance steps with open arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends the knees and twists the torso back and forth, alternating open hand positions while stepping, then settles with one hand near the waist.

takes.title: Yawn and stretch with arms opened wide
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands toward the face, stretches the arms up and outward, then lowers them to the sides.

takes.title: Punch and high kick combination
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises the hands near the chest, punches across the body, extends a leg into two high kicks, then steps out of the sequence.

takes.title: Range-of-motion sequence with kicks and crouch
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through raised elbows and arms overhead, high knee lifts and kicks, then crouches and finishes with both arms extended sideways.

takes.title: Raise one hand and wave
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises one forearm with the palm outward, makes a brief greeting wave, and lowers the hand while shifting weight.

takes.title: Lower into a stool-sit posture and rise
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts one knee while stepping into place, lowers the hips into a seated posture, then stands and steps away. The source identifies a stool.

takes.title: Peekaboo with both hands near the face
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands up to the face, changes their position several times as if hiding and revealing the face, then lowers the arms and steps away.

takes.title: Relaxed walk with changes in facing
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks casually with small arm swings, turns through several directions, and settles upright at the end.

takes.title: Waiting stance with small gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts weight and turns in place, briefly lifts both hands, then brings one hand toward the face with the feet still close.

takes.title: Two-handed shrug
takes.actionDescription: The performer stands with feet offset, rotates both forearms out with the palms up, and drops both arms again.
takes.reviewNote: The byte-identical match 106_21 label says bad AMC. The loaded capture shows a continuous shrug in the reviewed frames. Compare the source and denser playback to identify the reported issue.

takes.title: One-handed high-five gesture
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps in, raises one hand near head height, extends it forward and outward, then retracts it while stepping away.

takes.title: Handshake mime while stepping forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks in, reaches one hand forward at waist height, pulls it back, and resumes walking with the arms down.

takes.sourceDescription: Around the world High Five Low
takes.title: High-to-low sweeping greeting gesture
takes.actionDescription: The performer approaches, raises one hand near the head, sweeps it outward and down, then turns through a step. The source calls it a high-five variation.

takes.title: Walk and turn with long steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks through changes of direction with long alternating strides and loose arm swings, ending side-on.

takes.title: Curtsy with both arms opening
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps forward, crosses one foot back, bends the knees and spreads the arms, then straightens and walks out.

takes.title: Slow walk with a lowered head
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes small slow steps with arms hanging, lowers the head, and turns to a quiet side-on finish.

takes.title: Playful hand slap and return gesture
takes.actionDescription: The performer approaches, extends one hand sideways, retracts it and raises it back toward the face, then continues stepping.

takes.title: Wandering walk with frequent turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks at a casual pace, shifts through a number of changes in facing, and keeps stepping through the finish.

takes.title: Short wandering walk
takes.actionDescription: The performer strings together short stretches of forward walking and turns, keeping the arm swing small.

takes.title: Backward walk with a turn
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes measured backward steps with the arms relaxed, briefly turns through the sequence, and continues stepping back.

takes.title: Sideways walk with crossing steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves laterally, crossing one foot past the other and reopening the stance between steps while the arms hang loosely.

takes.title: Sideways walk with feet brought together
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes small lateral steps, drawing the trailing foot close to the lead foot before the next step.

takes.title: Short run after a walking start
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with short steps, quickens into a springing run with the arms bent, then winds down near the end.
